html:
An insurgency by jihadist groups linked to al-Qaeda and the Islamic State, which spread into northern and eastern Burkina Faso from Mali from 2015.

Attacks on soldiers, villages, schools and churches grew each year. Local self-defence militias and army reprisals turned the war ethnic, with Fula civilians often targeted. In the worst massacres, at Solhan in 2021 and Barsalogho in 2024, hundreds of people were killed. More than two million people fled their homes, and large parts of the country are beyond state control. Anger at the army's failures led to two coups in 2022 and the rule of Ibrahim Traore. See also the Mali War.
sum: An insurgency by jihadist groups linked to al-Qaeda and the Islamic State, which spread into northern and eastern Burkina Faso from Mali from 2015.
